name: Jedi Enclave
blurb: An enclave on a temple world. Every repo is a training hall, the Falcon is docked at the edge of it, and Vader walks among them.

yavin.name: Temple World
yavin.blurb: Jungle to the horizon, stone under the vines, a gas giant overhead.

dunesea.name: Dune Sea
dunesea.blurb: Twin suns, no shade, and a long way to the nearest settlement.
